intended_sources: One Click LCA / EPDs processed or generated in its ecosystem
coverage_note: Built from authoritative ILCD+EPD master data and format requirements plus representative English EPD table variants. It is designed to generalize across EPDs; no finite alias dictionary can guarantee 100% coverage of every historical or future PDF layout.

match_priority: ILCD refObjectId/UUID when the identifier is known for the detected method profile
exact canonical abbreviation + detected EN15804 profile
exact normalized English long name + compatible unit + section context
exact alias + compatible unit + section context
fuzzy alias matching only as a last resort; never accept fuzzy result without unit/section/standard checks
standard_disambiguation: Do not merge EN15804+A1 and EN15804+A2 impact values into the same method profile.
AP: kg SO2 eq strongly indicates +A1; mol H+ eq strongly indicates +A2.
EP: one unsplit kg phosphate/PO4 indicator strongly indicates +A1; freshwater/marine/terrestrial split indicates +A2.
POCP: kg ethene/C2H4 eq indicates +A1; kg NMVOC eq indicates +A2.
If the standard is unknown, store the raw result and mark method_profile='unresolved' rather than guessing.

aggregate_only.condition: A1-A3 reported but A1/A2/A3 not reported
aggregate_only.action: Store the value under A1-A3 with provenance='reported'. Leave A1, A2 and A3 null.

split_only.condition: A1, A2 and A3 reported but A1-A3 not reported
split_only.action: Store A1/A2/A3 as reported. Optionally compute A1-A3_calculated = A1+A2+A3 with provenance='calculated'; never label it reported.

split_plus_reported_total.condition: A1, A2, A3 and A1-A3 are all reported
split_plus_reported_total.action: Store all four reported values. Compare sum(A1,A2,A3) to reported A1-A3 using rounding-aware QA; do not overwrite the reported total.

partial_split.condition: Only some of A1/A2/A3 are reported
partial_split.action: Store only what is explicitly reported. Do not derive missing components from A1-A3.

module_header_normalization.important_note: Do not infer numeric modules from prose such as 'A1 to A3' unless it is in a result-table header or explicitly marked as an aggregate result.

number_parsing.thousands_separator_policy: Use table locale/context. Do not blindly remove commas because comma may be decimal separator.

missing_value_tokens.important_note: Numeric 0 or 0.00E+00 is a real zero, never a missing value. A dash '-' is context-sensitive and must not automatically become zero.

ocr_text_normalization: Unicode dashes (– — ‐ −) -> ASCII '-' for matching only; preserve raw text separately.
CO₂ -> CO2; SO₂ -> SO2; m³ -> m3; m² -> m2 for matching.
Superscript/subscript footnote digits attached to indicator codes should be stripped for matching.
Join line-broken indicator labels such as 'ADP-minerals &' + 'metals'.
Dehyphenate words broken at line endings when the PDF text layer inserts soft hyphens.
Collapse repeated whitespace, but preserve table cell boundaries in the extraction layer.
Keep both raw_text and normalized_text for auditability.

additional_impact: Potential environmental impact - additional mandatory and voluntary indicators

context_disambiguation: WDP vs FW: use table section + unit + indicator label; never map bare 'water use' globally.
EEE/EET vs generic EE: keep generic exported energy as EE_TOTAL unless electricity/thermal is explicitly stated.
Density may mean gross density in product-property context; preserve raw field label.
Declared unit and functional unit are not interchangeable; store both if both are present.

confidence_levels.1.00: Exact known ILCD UUID/refObjectId for detected method profile
confidence_levels.0.98: Exact canonical code + compatible method profile + compatible unit
confidence_levels.0.95: Exact canonical/long name + compatible unit + section
confidence_levels.<0.80: Require manual review; fuzzy match only

A1-A3.policy: Never split a reported A1-A3 value into A1, A2 and A3.

A1-A4.policy: Capture if reported, but do not treat as a substitute for canonical module values.

A1-A5.policy: Capture separately; do not back-calculate constituent modules.

qa_rules.module_d_policy: Always store module D separately. Do not subtract D from A-C unless a downstream calculation explicitly requests that operation.

reference_basis.ILCD_Handbook_General_Guide: Conceptual LCA meaning and methodological basis (ISO 14040/14044 aligned).
reference_basis.ILCD_Documentation_of_LCA_Data_Sets_1_1_: Relationships among process, flow, flow-property, unit-group, source, contact and LCIA-method datasets.
reference_basis.ILCD_Format_1_1_Process_Data_Set: Identification, quantitative reference, time, geography, technology, modelling/validation, administrative information, exchanges and LCIA results.
reference_basis.ILCD_Common_Data_Types: UUID/object references, versions, URI, short descriptions, multilingual strings and dates.
reference_basis.ILCD_Unit_Group_Data_Set: Canonical unit groups and unit references.
reference_basis.ILCD_Flow_and_Flow_Property_Data_Sets: Reference product flow, product/waste/elementary flows and physical flow properties.
reference_basis.ILCD_plus_EPD: Construction-EPD extension for EN 15804 module-wise values, scenarios and digital EPD master data.
reference_basis.ILCD_plus_EPD_Master_Data: Canonical LCIA indicator and resource/waste/output-flow UUIDs for EN 15804 profiles.
reference_basis.ILCD_LCIA_Recommendations: Conceptual meaning of environmental impact indicators.
